description: This is a source file defining an actor 'DiagnosticsFileLog' in Swift that manages logging diagnostic information into a JSONL file, with support for log rotation, enabling/disabling via user defaults, and thread-safe append operations.

classes.name: DiagnosticsFileLog
classes.description: An actor responsible for managing log entries, including writing, rotation, and directory management, with static methods for configuration and instance methods for operational logging.

methods.name: isEnabled
methods.description: Checks whether logging is enabled based on user defaults.

methods.name: logDirectoryURL
methods.description: Returns the URL of the directory where logs are stored.

methods.name: logFileURL
methods.description: Returns the URL for the current log file.

methods.name: log
methods.description: Public method to log an event with category, event name, and optional fields.

methods.name: clear
methods.description: Clears all log files, including rotated backups.

methods.name: write
methods.description: Private method to write a record to the log file, with internal error handling.

methods.name: ensureDirectory
methods.description: Creates the log directory if it does not exist.

methods.name: append
methods.description: Appends a log record to the log file, encoding as JSON and adding a newline.

methods.name: rotateIfNeeded
methods.description: Performs log rotation if the size exceeds maximum size, managing backup files.

methods.name: rotatedURL
methods.description: Generates the URL for a rotated backup file based on an index.
